490	def _validate_animation_reference(ref: Any, phase: str, path: str, known_ids: set[str]) -> None:
491	    if isinstance(ref, str):
492	        animation_id = ref
493	    elif isinstance(ref, dict):
494	        _raise_unknown_keys(path, ref, frozenset({"id", "durationFrames", "easing", "params"}))
495	        animation_id = ref.get("id")
496	        if "durationFrames" in ref and (
497	            not isinstance(ref.get("durationFrames"), (int, float)) or float(ref["durationFrames"]) <= 0
498	        ):
499	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.durationFrames must be a positive number")
500	        if "easing" in ref and not isinstance(ref.get("easing"), str):
501	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.easing must be a string")
502	        if "params" in ref and not isinstance(ref.get("params"), dict):
503	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.params must be an object")
504	    else:
505	        raise ValueError(f"{path} must be an animation id string or object")
506	    if not isinstance(animation_id, str) or not animation_id:
507	        raise ValueError(f"{path}.id must be a non-empty string")
508	    if known_ids and animation_id not in known_ids:
509	        raise ValueError(f"{path} animation id {animation_id!r} is not present in the animations catalog")
510	    meta = _animation_meta(animation_id)
511	    meta_phase = meta.get("phase")
512	    phase_matches = (
513	        meta_phase in (None, "any", phase)
514	        or (isinstance(meta_phase, list) and phase in meta_phase)
515	    )
516	    if not phase_matches:
517	        raise ValueError(f"{path} animation {animation_id!r} has phase {meta_phase!r}, expected {phase!r}")
518	
519	def _validate_animation_reference_list(value: Any, phase: str, path: str, known_ids: set[str]) -> None:
520	    if value is None:
521	        return
522	    refs = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
523	    if not refs:
524	        raise ValueError(f"{path} must not be an empty animation list")
525	    for index, ref in enumerate(refs):
526	        _validate_animation_reference(ref, phase, f"{path}[{index}]", known_ids)
527	
528	def _schema_params_for_animation_refs(schema: dict[str, Any], params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
529	    """Keep legacy strict effect schemas usable while standardized animation refs roll out."""
530	    properties = schema.get("properties")
531	    if not isinstance(properties, dict):
532	        return params
533	    next_params = dict(params)
534	    for phase in ("entrance", "sustain", "exit"):
535	        if phase not in next_params:
536	            continue
537	        prop = properties.get(phase)
538	        if not isinstance(prop, dict):
539	            next_params.pop(phase)
540	            continue
541	        enum = prop.get("enum")
542	        if isinstance(enum, list) and "none" in enum:
543	            next_params[phase] = "none"
544	        elif prop.get("type") == "string":
545	            next_params[phase] = "none"
546	    return next_params
547	
548	def _validate_effect_params(effect_id: str, params: Any, path: str, theme: str | None = None) -> None:
549	    if params is None:
550	        return
551	    if not isinstance(params, dict):
552	        raise ValueError(f"{path} must be an object")
553	    known_animation_ids = _animation_ids()
554	    for phase in ("entrance", "sustain", "exit"):
555	        if phase in params:
556	            _validate_animation_reference_list(params[phase], phase, f"{path}.{phase}", known_animation_ids)
557	    try:
558	        from artagents.core.element import catalog as effects_catalog
559	        import jsonschema  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
560	    except ImportError:
561	        try:
562	            from artagents.core.element import catalog as effects_catalog  # type: ignore[no-redef]
563	            import jsonschema  # type: ignore[import-not-found,no-redef]
564	        except ImportError:
565	            return
566	    schema = effects_catalog.read_effect_schema(effect_id, theme=theme)
567	    jsonschema.validate(_schema_params_for_animation_refs(schema, params), schema)

569	def _transition_reference(value: Any, path: str) -> tuple[str, float | None]:
570	    if isinstance(value, str):
571	        return value, None
572	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
573	        raise ValueError(f"{path} must be a transition id string or object")
574	    _raise_unknown_keys(path, value, frozenset({"id", "type", "duration", "durationFrames", "params"}))
575	    transition_id = value.get("id", value.get("type"))
576	    if not isinstance(transition_id, str) or not transition_id:
577	        raise ValueError(f"{path}.id must be a non-empty string")
578	    if "params" in value and not isinstance(value.get("params"), dict):
579	        raise ValueError(f"{path}.params must be an object")
580	    duration_frames = value.get("durationFrames")
581	    duration_seconds = value.get("duration")
582	    if duration_frames is not None:
583	        if not isinstance(duration_frames, (int, float)) or float(duration_frames) <= 0:
584	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.durationFrames must be a positive number")
585	        return transition_id, float(duration_frames)
586	    if duration_seconds is not None:
587	        if not isinstance(duration_seconds, (int, float)) or float(duration_seconds) <= 0:
588	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.duration must be a positive number")
589	        return transition_id, None
590	    return transition_id, None
591	
592	def _clip_duration_seconds(clip: dict[str, Any]) -> float | None:
593	    hold = clip.get("hold")
594	    if isinstance(hold, (int, float)) and float(hold) >= 0:
595	        return float(hold)
596	    start = clip.get("from", 0)
597	    end = clip.get("to")
598	    if isinstance(start, (int, float)) and isinstance(end, (int, float)) and float(end) >= float(start):
599	        return float(end) - float(start)
600	    return None
601	
602	def _validate_clip_transitions(clips: list[dict[str, Any]], fps: float) -> None:
603	    known_ids = _transition_ids()
604	    by_track: dict[str, list[tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
605	    for index, clip in enumerate(clips):
606	        track = clip.get("track")
607	        if isinstance(track, str):
608	            by_track.setdefault(track, []).append((index, clip))
609	    for track_clips in by_track.values():
610	        track_clips.sort(key=lambda item: float(item[1].get("at", 0)))
611	        for position, (index, clip) in enumerate(track_clips):
612	            if "transition" not in clip:
613	                continue
614	            transition_id, duration_frames = _transition_reference(clip["transition"], f"clips[{index}].transition")
615	            if known_ids and transition_id not in known_ids:
616	                raise ValueError(
617	                    f"clips[{index}].transition id {transition_id!r} is not present in the transitions catalog"
618	                )
619	            next_clip = track_clips[position + 1][1] if position + 1 < len(track_clips) else None
620	            current_duration = _clip_duration_seconds(clip)
621	            next_duration = _clip_duration_seconds(next_clip) if next_clip is not None else None
622	            duration_seconds = duration_frames / fps if duration_frames is not None else None
623	            if duration_seconds is None and isinstance(clip.get("transition"), dict):
624	                raw_duration = clip["transition"].get("duration")
625	                duration_seconds = float(raw_duration) if isinstance(raw_duration, (int, float)) else None
626	            if duration_seconds is None or current_duration is None or next_duration is None:
627	                continue
628	            if duration_seconds > current_duration or duration_seconds > next_duration:
629	                raise ValueError(
630	                    f"clips[{index}].transition duration {duration_seconds:.3f}s must fit both adjacent same-track clips"
631	                )
632	
633	def _timeline_fps(config: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
634	    """Best-effort fps for timeline-internal validation (transitions, etc.).
635	
636	    The authoritative fps comes from theme.visual.canvas at render time. This helper
637	    looks for a theme_overrides override; otherwise it returns a sentinel default
638	    (30) used only for clip-transition duration checks.
639	    """
640	    overrides = config.get("theme_overrides")
641	    if isinstance(overrides, dict):
642	        visual = overrides.get("visual")
643	        if isinstance(visual, dict):
644	            canvas = visual.get("canvas")
645	            if isinstance(canvas, dict):
646	                fps_value = canvas.get("fps")
647	                if isinstance(fps_value, (int, float)) and float(fps_value) > 0:
648	                    return float(fps_value)
649	    return 30.0
650

669	def _asset_entry_for_clip(
670	    clip: Mapping[str, Any],
671	    registry: AssetRegistry | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
672	) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
673	    asset_key = clip.get("asset")
674	    if not isinstance(asset_key, str) or not isinstance(registry, Mapping):
675	        return None
676	    assets = registry.get("assets")
677	    if not isinstance(assets, Mapping):
678	        return None
679	    entry = assets.get(asset_key)
680	    return entry if isinstance(entry, Mapping) else None

683	def _asset_kind_from_entry(entry: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> ClipClassifiedKind | None:
684	    if not isinstance(entry, Mapping):
685	        return None
686	    raw_type = entry.get("type")
687	    if isinstance(raw_type, str):
688	        normalized = raw_type.lower()
689	        if normalized in {"video", "image", "audio"}:
690	            return ClipClassifiedKind(normalized)
691	        if normalized.startswith("video/"):
692	            return ClipClassifiedKind.VIDEO
693	        if normalized.startswith("image/"):
694	            return ClipClassifiedKind.IMAGE
695	        if normalized.startswith("audio/"):
696	            return ClipClassifiedKind.AUDIO
697	    for key in ("mime", "mimeType", "contentType"):
698	        mime = entry.get(key)
699	        if not isinstance(mime, str):
700	            continue
701	        normalized = mime.lower()
702	        if normalized.startswith("video/"):
703	            return ClipClassifiedKind.VIDEO
704	        if normalized.startswith("image/"):
705	            return ClipClassifiedKind.IMAGE
706	        if normalized.startswith("audio/"):
707	            return ClipClassifiedKind.AUDIO
708	    return None
709	
710	
711	def _classify_clip(
712	    clip: Mapping[str, Any],
713	    registry: AssetRegistry | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
714	    *,
715	    theme: str | None = None,
716	) -> ClipClassifiedKind:
717	    clip_type = clip.get("clipType", "media")
718	    if clip_type == "text":
719	        return ClipClassifiedKind.TEXT
720	    if clip_type == "media":
721	        return _asset_kind_from_entry(_asset_entry_for_clip(clip, registry)) or ClipClassifiedKind.OPAQUE
722	    if clip_type in {"hold"}:
723	        return _asset_kind_from_entry(_asset_entry_for_clip(clip, registry)) or ClipClassifiedKind.VIDEO
724	    if clip_type == "effect-layer":
725	        return ClipClassifiedKind.EFFECT
726	    if isinstance(clip_type, str) and clip_type in _effect_ids(theme):
727	        return ClipClassifiedKind.EFFECT
728	    return ClipClassifiedKind.OPAQUE

765	class Timeline:
766	    """Persisted timeline JSON with top-level passthrough fields preserved."""
767	
768	    def __init__(self, config: Mapping[str, Any], *, validate: bool = True) -> None:
769	        data = copy.deepcopy(dict(config))
770	        if validate:
771	            validate_timeline(data)
772	        self._data = data
773	
774	    @classmethod
775	    def from_json_data(cls, payload: Mapping[str, Any], *, validate: bool = True) -> "Timeline":
776	        data = copy.deepcopy(dict(payload))
777	        clips = data.get("clips")
778	        if isinstance(clips, list):
779	            data["clips"] = [

861	def merge_generation(
862	    theme_generation: dict[str, Any] | None,
863	    per_clip: dict[str, Any] | None,
864	) -> dict[str, Any]:
865	    """Merge per-clip generation atop the resolved theme.generation block.
866	
867	    Per-clip keys win on conflict. Lists (references, assets) are replaced wholesale,
868	    not merged. Returns an empty dict if both inputs are empty/None.
869	    """
870	    merged: dict[str, Any] = {}
871	    if isinstance(theme_generation, dict):
872	        merged.update(theme_generation)
873	    if isinstance(per_clip, dict):
874	        merged.update(per_clip)
875	    return merged

878	def _deep_merge_theme(base: dict[str, Any], overlay: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
879	    """Merge overlay onto base for theme blocks.
880	
881	    Top-level theme keys (visual, generation, voice, audio, pacing) are merged at one
882	    level deep. Nested dicts inside (e.g. visual.canvas) are merged key-by-key. Lists
883	    such as generation.references and generation.assets are replaced wholesale.
884	    """
885	    result: dict[str, Any] = {key: value for key, value in base.items()}
886	    for key, value in overlay.items():
887	        if (
888	            key in result
889	            and isinstance(result[key], dict)
890	            and isinstance(value, dict)
891	        ):
892	            merged_block: dict[str, Any] = dict(result[key])
893	            for sub_key, sub_value in value.items():
894	                if (
895	                    sub_key in merged_block
896	                    and isinstance(merged_block[sub_key], dict)
897	                    and isinstance(sub_value, dict)
898	                ):
899	                    inner = dict(merged_block[sub_key])
900	                    inner.update(sub_value)
901	                    merged_block[sub_key] = inner
902	                else:
903	                    merged_block[sub_key] = sub_value
904	            result[key] = merged_block
905	        else:
906	            result[key] = value
907	    return result

910	def resolve_timeline_theme(timeline: "TimelineConfig", themes_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
911	    """Return the merged theme view: theme.json + timeline.theme_overrides.
912	
913	    `timeline['theme']` is a slug resolved against `<themes_root>/<slug>/theme.json`.
914	    Overrides are deep-merged onto the loaded theme; list-valued fields (references,
915	    assets) are replaced wholesale by the override.
916	    """
917	    slug = timeline.get("theme") if isinstance(timeline, dict) else None
918	    if not isinstance(slug, str) or not slug:
919	        raise ValueError("Timeline.theme must be a non-empty slug")
920	    theme_path = Path(themes_root) / slug / "theme.json"
921	    if not theme_path.is_file():
922	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Theme {slug!r} not found at {theme_path}")
923	    base = json.loads(theme_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
924	    if not isinstance(base, dict):
925	        raise ValueError(f"Theme file {theme_path} must contain a JSON object")
926	    overrides = timeline.get("theme_overrides") if isinstance(timeline, dict) else None
927	    if isinstance(overrides, dict) and overrides:
928	        return _deep_merge_theme(base, overrides)
929	    return base

969	def _assign_missing_arrangement_uuids(arrangement: Any) -> bool:
970	    if not isinstance(arrangement, dict):
971	        return False
972	    clips = arrangement.get("clips")
973	    if not isinstance(clips, list):
974	        return False
975	    used = {
976	        clip.get("uuid")
977	        for clip in clips
978	        if isinstance(clip, dict) and isinstance(clip.get("uuid"), str)
979	    }
980	    assigned = False
981	    for clip in clips:
982	        if not isinstance(clip, dict) or "uuid" in clip:
983	            continue
984	        value = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
985	        while value in used:
986	            value = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
987	        used.add(value)
988	        clip["uuid"] = value
989	        assigned = True
990	        order = clip.get("order")
991	        print(f"timeline.load_arrangement: migrated clip order={order} uuid={value}", file=sys.stderr)
992	    return assigned

1003	        migrated = _assign_missing_arrangement_uuids(data)
1004	    validate_arrangement(data, pool_ids)
1005	    if migrated:

1007	    return data  # type: ignore[return-value]

1013	def validate_registry(registry: Any) -> None:
1014	    if not isinstance(registry, dict):
1015	        raise ValueError("Asset registry must be a JSON object")
1016	    _raise_unknown_keys("Asset registry", registry, frozenset({"assets"}))
1017	    assets = registry.get("assets")
1018	    if not isinstance(assets, dict):
1019	        raise ValueError("Asset registry.assets must be an object")
1020	    for key, entry in assets.items():
1021	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
1022	            raise ValueError(f"Asset registry.assets[{key!r}] must be an object")
1023	        _raise_unknown_keys(f"Asset registry.assets[{key!r}]", entry, _ASSET_ENTRY_ALLOWED)
1024	        if "file" not in entry and "url" not in entry:
1025	            raise ValueError(f"Asset {key!r} must have 'file' or 'url'")
1026	        url = entry.get("url")
1027	        if url is not None and (not isinstance(url, str) or not url.startswith(("http://", "https://"))):
1028	            raise ValueError(f"Asset {key!r}.url must be an http(s) URL")
1029	        content_sha256 = entry.get("content_sha256")
1030	        if content_sha256 is not None and (
1031	            not isinstance(content_sha256, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", content_sha256) is None
1032	        ):
1033	            raise ValueError(f"Asset {key!r}.content_sha256 must be a 64-character lowercase hex string")
1034	        if "url_expires_at" in entry:
1035	            _validate_generated_at(entry.get("url_expires_at"), f"Asset {key!r}.url_expires_at")
1036	        etag = entry.get("etag")
1037	        if etag is not None and (not isinstance(etag, str) or not etag):
1038	            raise ValueError(f"Asset {key!r}.etag must be a non-empty string")

1040	def validate_timeline(config: Any, *, strict: bool = True) -> None:
1041	    """Validate a Banodoco timeline.
1042	
1043	    `clipType` is an open string for Reigh compatibility. Built-in media/text
1044	    clips and registered effects get semantic checks where ArtAgents knows how;
1045	    unknown clip types stay valid and classify as opaque at runtime.
1046	
1047	    Callers that need to accept legacy/under-construction timelines (e.g.
1048	    in-flight pipeline outputs that reference theme content not yet on
1049	    disk) can opt into `strict=False`.
1050	    """
1051	    if not isinstance(config, dict):
1052	        raise ValueError("Timeline must be a JSON object")
1053	    theme = config.get("theme")
1054	    if theme is not None and (not isinstance(theme, str) or not theme):
1055	        raise ValueError("Timeline.theme must be a non-empty slug")
1056	    # Shape-check against the shared JSON Schema first; then run the
1057	    # Banodoco-only semantic checks (effect-id registry, transition durations).
1058	    normalized_for_shared = _known_timeline_payload(config)
1059	    if isinstance(normalized_for_shared.get("clips"), list):
1060	        normalized_for_shared["clips"] = [
1061	            _normalize_clip_for_validation(c) if isinstance(c, dict) else c
1062	            for c in normalized_for_shared["clips"]
1063	        ]
1064	    _shared_validate_timeline(normalized_for_shared, strict=strict)
1065	    fps = _timeline_fps(config)
1066	    tracks = config.get("tracks")
1067	    if tracks is not None:
1068	        if not isinstance(tracks, list):
1069	            raise ValueError("Timeline.tracks must be a list")
1070	        for index, track in enumerate(tracks):
1071	            if not isinstance(track, dict):
1072	                raise ValueError(f"tracks[{index}] must be an object")
1073	            _raise_unknown_keys(f"tracks[{index}]", track, _TRACK_ALLOWED)
1074	            for field in ("id", "kind", "label"):
1075	                if field not in track:
1076	                    raise ValueError(f"tracks[{index}].{field} is required")
1077	    overrides = config.get("theme_overrides")
1078	    if overrides is not None:
1079	        if not isinstance(overrides, dict):
1080	            raise ValueError("Timeline.theme_overrides must be an object")
1081	        _raise_unknown_keys("Timeline.theme_overrides", overrides, _THEME_OVERRIDES_ALLOWED)
1082	    clips = config.get("clips")
1083	    if not isinstance(clips, list):
1084	        raise ValueError("Timeline.clips must be a list")
1085	    clip_ids: set[str] = set()
1086	    normalized_clips: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
1087	    for index, clip_raw in enumerate(clips):
1088	        if not isinstance(clip_raw, dict):
1089	            raise ValueError(f"clips[{index}] must be an object")
1090	        clip = _normalize_clip_for_validation(clip_raw)
1091	        normalized_clips.append(clip)
1092	        _raise_unknown_keys(f"clips[{index}]", clip, _CLIP_ALLOWED)
1093	        for field in ("id", "at", "track"):
1094	            if field not in clip:
1095	                raise ValueError(f"clips[{index}].{field} is required")
1096	        clip_type = clip.get("clipType", "media")
1097	        if not isinstance(clip_type, str):
1098	            raise ValueError(f"clips[{index}].clipType must be a string")
1099	        # Active theme slug from the timeline lets effect-id scans pick up
1100	        # theme-scoped clipTypes (e.g. 2rp's section-hook). Open-string
1101	        # clipTypes that are not registered effects remain opaque.
1102	        active_theme = theme if isinstance(theme, str) else None
1103	        effect_ids = _effect_ids(active_theme)
1104	        if clip_type in effect_ids:
1105	            _validate_effect_params(clip_type, clip.get("params"), f"clips[{index}].params", theme=active_theme)
1106	        if "pool_id" in clip and not isinstance(clip["pool_id"], str):
1107	            raise ValueError(f"clips[{index}].pool_id must be a string")
1108	        if "clip_order" in clip:
1109	            order = clip["clip_order"]
1110	            if not isinstance(order, int) or isinstance(order, bool) or order <= 0:
1111	                raise ValueError(f"clips[{index}].clip_order must be a positive integer")
1112	        if clip["id"] in clip_ids:
1113	            raise ValueError(f"clips[{index}].id {clip['id']!r} is not unique")
1114	        clip_ids.add(clip["id"])
1115	    _validate_clip_transitions(normalized_clips, float(fps))

1160	def validate_pool(pool: Any) -> None:
1161	    if not isinstance(pool, dict):
1162	        raise ValueError("Pool must be a JSON object")
1163	    _raise_unknown_keys("Pool", pool, _POOL_ALLOWED)
1164	    if pool.get("version") != POOL_VERSION:
1165	        raise ValueError(f"Pool.version must be {POOL_VERSION}")
1166	    _validate_generated_at(pool.get("generated_at"), "Pool.generated_at")
1167	    source_slug = pool.get("source_slug")
1168	    if source_slug is not None and not isinstance(source_slug, str):
1169	        raise ValueError("Pool.source_slug must be a string")
1170	    entries = pool.get("entries")
1171	    if not isinstance(entries, list):
1172	        raise ValueError("Pool.entries must be a list")
1173	    seen_ids: set[str] = set()
1174	    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
1175	        path = f"Pool.entries[{index}]"
1176	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
1177	            raise ValueError(f"{path} must be an object")
1178	        _raise_unknown_keys(path, entry, _POOL_ENTRY_ALLOWED)
1179	        for field in ("id", "kind", "category", "duration", "scores", "excluded"):
1180	            if field not in entry:
1181	                raise ValueError(f"{path}.{field} is required")
1182	        entry_id = entry["id"]
1183	        if not isinstance(entry_id, str) or not entry_id:
1184	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.id must be a non-empty string")
1185	        if entry_id in seen_ids:
1186	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.id {entry_id!r} is not unique")
1187	        seen_ids.add(entry_id)
1188	        if entry.get("kind") not in {"source", "generative"}:
1189	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.kind must be one of source, generative")
1190	        if entry.get("category") not in {"dialogue", "visual", "reaction", "applause", "music"}:
1191	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.category must be one of dialogue, visual, reaction, applause, music")
1192	        _validate_pool_scores(entry["scores"], f"{path}.scores")
1193	        if not isinstance(entry.get("excluded"), bool):
1194	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.excluded must be a boolean")
1195	        excluded_reason = entry.get("excluded_reason")
1196	        if excluded_reason is not None and not isinstance(excluded_reason, str):
1197	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.excluded_reason must be a string or null")
1198	        if entry["kind"] == "source":
1199	            for field in ("asset", "src_start", "src_end", "duration", "source_ids"):
1200	                if field not in entry:
1201	                    raise ValueError(f"{path}.{field} is required for source entries")
1202	            if not isinstance(entry.get("asset"), str) or not entry["asset"]:
1203	                raise ValueError(f"{path}.asset must be a non-empty string")
1204	            for field in ("src_start", "src_end", "duration"):
1205	                if not isinstance(entry.get(field), (int, float)):
1206	                    raise ValueError(f"{path}.{field} must be numeric")
1207	            if float(entry["src_start"]) < 0 or float(entry["src_end"]) < 0 or float(entry["duration"]) < 0:
1208	                raise ValueError(f"{path} timing values must be non-negative")
1209	            if float(entry["src_end"]) < float(entry["src_start"]):
1210	                raise ValueError(f"{path}.src_end must be >= src_start")
1211	            _validate_source_ids(entry["source_ids"], f"{path}.source_ids")
1212	        else:
1213	            for field in ("effect_id", "param_schema", "defaults", "meta"):
1214	                if field not in entry:
1215	                    raise ValueError(f"{path}.{field} is required for generative entries")
1216	            if entry.get("duration") is not None:
1217	                raise ValueError(f"{path}.duration must be null for generative entries")
1218	            effect_id = entry.get("effect_id")
1219	            if not isinstance(effect_id, str) or not effect_id:
1220	                raise ValueError(f"{path}.effect_id must be a non-empty string")
1221	            if effect_id not in _effect_ids():
1222	                raise ValueError(f"{path}.effect_id {effect_id!r} is not present in the effects catalog")
1223	            for field in ("param_schema", "defaults", "meta"):
1224	                if not isinstance(entry.get(field), dict):
1225	                    raise ValueError(f"{path}.{field} must be an object")

1240	def validate_arrangement_duration_window(
1241	    arrangement: Any,
1242	    *,
1243	    min_sec: float = 75.0,
1244	    max_sec: float = 90.0,
1245	) -> None:

1254	def is_all_generative_arrangement(arrangement: Any, pool: Any) -> bool:
1255	    if not isinstance(arrangement, dict) or not isinstance(pool, dict):
1256	        return False
1257	    entries = {
1258	        entry.get("id"): entry
1259	        for entry in pool.get("entries", [])
1260	        if isinstance(entry, dict) and isinstance(entry.get("id"), str)
1261	    }
1262	    referenced: set[str] = set()
1263	    for clip in arrangement.get("clips", []):
1264	        if not isinstance(clip, dict):

1270	    if not referenced:
1271	        return False
1272	    return all(isinstance(entries.get(pool_id), dict) and entries[pool_id].get("kind") == "generative" for pool_id in referenced)

# Critique: Option 3a (`clip_overrides` mirrors `TimelineClip`)

## 1. Coupling cost is worse than it looks

The proposal frames coupling as "we mirror the TS Zod minus identity." The actual coupling surface is bigger than `TimelineClip`'s field list — it's also the *semantics* of those fields under the Banodoco validator (`artagents/timeline.py:_validate_clip_transitions`, `_validate_effect_params`), the `from_`/`from` boundary swap (`_FROM_ALIAS`, `_swap_from_load`/`_swap_from_dump`), and the `_CLIP_ALLOWED` frozenset (lines 359–367). The Banodoco TS schema is *open* on `clipType` (SD-024) and on `effects`/`transition` shapes (Zod unions: `z.array(TimelineEffect) | z.record(z.number())`, `ClipTransition | ClipTransitionReference | string`). Mirroring those into placement means we have to (a) re-encode the Zod unions in Python validation, or (b) accept opaque pass-through, which is exactly what the placement layer was trying to *avoid* by typing things at all.

Concrete failure modes when Banodoco evolves:
- **New optional field added to `TimelineClip`** (e.g. `rotation`): placement validator rejects it as unknown unless we open `clip_overrides` to passthrough, in which case the type-safety story is a fiction.
- **Existing field semantics change** (e.g. `effects` becomes always-array, dropping the `Record<string, number>` arm): every saved `timeline.json` with a `clip_overrides.effects` map silently materializes invalid clips. We discover this only at `validate_timeline` time during materialize.
- **Field renamed or split** (e.g. `cropTop/Bottom/Left/Right` → `crop: {top, bottom, left, right}`): all placements break at materialize. AA cannot hot-fix because the schema source-of-truth is in another repo.

The proposal's "minus identity (id/asset/track/clipType)" carve-out is also wrong on at least one count: `clipType` is *not* identity — it's an authoring decision. A placement that picks a run-clip generated as `media` may legitimately want to override to `hold` or to a theme-scoped effect clipType. If you exclude `clipType` from overrides you ship a hole; if you include it you've widened the coupling further.

## Run-clip-with-its-own-properties interaction

This is the real puzzle and the proposal hand-waves it. Look at `_clip_from_run_placement` (materialize.py:138–171): it `deepcopy`s the run-clip wholesale, then overlays the placement's *current* fields (`entrance`, `exit`, `transition`, `effects`, `params`) using *replace* semantics. Today the placement only wins on the five composition-y fields. With `clip_overrides`, the layering becomes three-deep: **base run-clip baked properties → user's `clip_overrides` → composition fields (`at`, `track`, `id`)**. If reigh-app authored the source run-clip with `opacity: 0.4`, and the user sets `clip_overrides.opacity: 0.8`, that's clear. But if reigh-app set `entrance: {type: "fade", duration: 0.5}` and the override sets `entrance: {duration: 1.0}` — does the override mean "fade for 1.0s" or "unset type, set duration"? The proposal says nothing.

## 2. Merge semantics — concrete cases

Spelling out what "base merged with overrides" actually has to do, field-by-field. The fields fall into four classes:

**(a) Scalar replace (clean):** `speed`, `hold`, `volume`, `opacity`, `x/y/width/height`, `cropTop/Bottom/Left/Right`, `from`, `to`, `source_uuid`, `pool_id`, `clip_order`. Override present → use override; absent → use base. Easy.

**(b) Object replace-vs-deep-merge (genuinely ambiguous):**
- `entrance` / `exit` / `continuous`: each is `{type, duration, intensity?, params?}`. If override is `{duration: 1.0}`, replacing the whole object would null out `type` and produce an invalid clip (Banodoco's `_validate_animation_reference` requires a non-empty `id`). Deep-merge feels right but then the user *cannot* "clear the entrance" with an override of `{}` — they need an explicit `null` sentinel, which JSON-on-disk validation doesn't naturally express.
- `text`: same problem. `{content: "hi"}` override should keep base font; `{}` override should... do what?
- `transition`: even worse — Banodoco accepts `string | ClipTransition | ClipTransitionReference`. If base is `"crossfade"` (string) and override is `{durationFrames: 30}` (object), you literally cannot deep-merge across the union arms.

**(c) Append vs replace — `effects`:** Banodoco's `effects` is `TimelineEffect[] | Record<string, number>`. Reigh-app run-clips typically come with an existing list. Does override append? Replace? Replace-by-id? There's no `id` on `TimelineEffect`. Append is the most useful semantics for the use case ("add a fade on top of what reigh produced"), but append on a `Record` is undefined. Today `materialize._clip_from_run_placement` *replaces* `effects` outright (line 157–159), which is already a footgun if reigh authored useful effects.

**(d) Generated/provenance fields — `source_uuid`, `pool_id`, `clip_order`, `generation`:** these are *carries*, not edits. Allowing override here is a category error; you'll get materialized timelines whose provenance fields disagree with the source run, and downstream tools that join on `source_uuid` will silently mis-attribute.

The merge is not one merge. It's at least four different policies, and (b)+(c) are genuinely undecidable without a sentinel-null convention or a more expressive override DSL (JSON Patch, RFC 7396 merge-patch with explicit `null` deletion). The proposal doesn't acknowledge this.

There's also an interaction with the *existing* placement fields that already overlap (`entrance`, `exit`, `transition`, `effects`, `params`, `from`, `to`). With `clip_overrides` added you now have three potential sources for `entrance` on a run-placement: the run-clip itself, `placement.entrance`, and `placement.clip_overrides.entrance`. Materialize.py would have to define precedence among all three. That's a smell.

## 3. Re-materialization & edit survival

This is where the proposal quietly fails the durability test. Today's contract:
- `placements[*]` is the user's authored intent; the file is `<project>/timeline.json`.
- The materialized output is *derived* — `write_materialized_project_timeline` writes `hype.timeline.json`/`hype.assets.json` to an `out_dir` chosen by the caller, separate from the project's authored state.

If a downstream tool re-runs (regenerating the run-clip behind `run_ref(run_id, clip_id)`):
- **Today (no overrides):** re-materialize picks up the new run-clip wholesale; the placement's `entrance`/`exit`/etc. (whatever's stored on the placement directly) are layered on top via `_clip_from_run_placement`. Survival is fine because the placement layer doesn't pretend to know about visual properties.
- **With `clip_overrides`:** the user's `width: 800` override survives. Good. But what if the *new* run-clip baked in `width: 1920` for a deliberate reason (reigh-app re-cropped after a model change)? The override now contradicts the source's intent silently. The user has no way to express "I overrode the OLD width because it was 1024; I don't actually care about width, I just wanted it to match the canvas" vs "I always want 800." There's no provenance on overrides.
- Worse: if the regenerated run-clip *removes* a field the override depended on (e.g. base used to have `text.content` and override set `text.fontSize: 48`; new base has no `text`), the merged clip is now `{fontSize: 48}` with no content — Banodoco may reject or render a nameless text clip.

A defensible answer requires either:
- **Snapshot the base** at the moment the override was authored, store `base_snapshot` next to `clip_overrides`, and warn on re-materialize when `base_snapshot != current_base` (drift detection). This works but bloats the placement and you've reinvented git for clip diffs.
- **Three-way merge:** treat the override as a diff against a snapshotted ancestor, do a real 3-way merge against the new base, surface conflicts. Correct but expensive engineering.
- **Explicit provenance per override field:** every override field carries a `because: "user-set" | "carried-from-base"` tag. Verbose.

The proposal as written does *none* of these. It just says "merged."

## 4. Alternatives — honest assessment

**(a) Embed clip fields directly into placement.** Strictly worse than 3a. You get the same Banodoco-coupling problem with a flatter shape and no namespace separating "composition fields" from "render fields." `placement.opacity` reads as if it's an authoring decision about the placement, but it's actually a property of the resolved clip — same conceptual confusion, fewer affordances for tooling that wants to ask "did the user override anything?"

**(c) Keep placement minimal, edit only on materialized output.** Honest about what the layer is for. The cost: round-trips. If the user materializes, opens in reigh-app, edits, then needs to re-run a generation upstream, their edits live on the materialized file and re-materialize blows them away. That breaks the workflow ArtAgents is supposed to enable (run agents, review, refine, re-run). Acceptable only if "materialized = terminal" is a hard rule, which contradicts the stated tension in the prompt.

**(d) Two-layer placement: composition placement + optional render placement.** This is the most architecturally clean option you listed. A `render` block (or sibling `render_overrides` with a *defined, smaller* schema — only the fields AA actually wants users to author at this layer) buys you:
- Explicit boundary: the composition placement is stable and AA-owned; the render block is the coupling surface and can be versioned independently.
- Schema stability through restricted scope: don't mirror *all* of `TimelineClip`. Pick the fields that are truly authoring-decisions at this level (`speed`, `opacity`, `volume`, `x/y/width/height`, `text.content`, `entrance.type`+`duration`) and leave `cropTop/Bottom/Left/Right`, `transition`'s string/object union, and provenance fields (`source_uuid`, `pool_id`, `clip_order`, `generation`) *out*. If you genuinely need everything, you've discovered that the placement layer IS the editor, and you should accept (c).
- Versionable: `render.schema_version` independent of `TIMELINE_SCHEMA_VERSION`. When Banodoco changes shape, you bump render schema and write a migrator inside AA, not at the boundary.

**(e) JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) semantics with explicit-null deletion.** A small extension to (d): define `clip_overrides` (or `render`) as RFC 7396, which gives you a real spec for object-vs-scalar merge and explicit `null` to delete. Ambiguity in 2(b) goes away. Doesn't solve `effects` (since 7396 replaces arrays — but that's at least *defined*) and doesn't solve `transition`'s union problem, but those are then small surgical exceptions documented in materialize.py rather than a general fog.

## 5. Recommendation

**Take alternative (d) with RFC 7396 merge semantics, not 3a.**

Concretely:
- Add `placement.render` (not `clip_overrides` — the name "overrides" prejudges the semantics). It is an AA-owned schema, *not* a mirror of `TimelineClip`.
- Whitelist the fields you actually want users to author at the placement layer. My starter list: `speed`, `opacity`, `volume`, `x`, `y`, `width`, `height`, `text.content`, and a *cleaner* `entrance`/`exit` shape. Explicitly reject `cropTop/Bottom/Left/Right` (replace with a single `crop: {t,b,l,r}` AA-side that materialize fans out — trivial), reject `transition` until you decide whether composition or render owns it (right now the placement already owns it, so leave it there), reject all provenance fields.
- Define merge as RFC 7396 over the whitelisted fields. Document explicitly: scalars replace, objects merge-patch, `null` deletes, `effects` is *append-with-id-collision-replace* (and add an `id` to AA-side effects entries to make this well-defined).
- For run-clip refs, snapshot a `render_base_digest` (sha256 of the run-clip's relevant fields at the moment of override authoring) into the placement. On re-materialize, if the digest doesn't match, log a warning with the diff and continue. Cheap, mechanical, honest about drift.
- Versioning: `placement.render.schema_version` independent of `TIMELINE_SCHEMA_VERSION`. When Banodoco's `TimelineClip` evolves, AA owns the migration story.

What you give up vs 3a: feature parity with reigh-app's editor at this layer. You will not be able to set `cropBottom` from a placement on day one. That's fine — if and when a real user actually wants it, you add it explicitly to the whitelist with one Python line and a test, instead of inheriting an entire foreign schema's evolution risk.

What you give up vs (c): nothing meaningful. (c) is the same architecture with the whitelist set to empty.

The reason 3a is wrong is that it conflates two different design goals — "let users set authoring properties from the placement layer" and "interoperate seamlessly with Banodoco's clip schema." 3a satisfies the second by sacrificing AA's ability to evolve the first. The placement layer is a Python-side authoring surface in a different repo from the schema's source of truth; that asymmetry is exactly when you write your own DTO and translate at the boundary, not when you mirror.

Push back on one assumption baked into the question itself: the prompt says "those ARE authoring decisions, not render-time decisions" about `speed`/`opacity`/`x/y/width/height`/`text`/`entrance/exit/transition`. That's true for *some* of them. `x/y/width/height` and `crop*` are absolutely render-time positioning of an asset whose dimensions you can't know without resolving the asset; treating them as placement-layer authoring decisions assumes the user knows the canvas dimensions when authoring a composition, which the placement layer was specifically trying to abstract over (placements reference `at`/`from`/`to` in seconds, not pixels). I'd seriously consider keeping geometry out of the placement layer entirely — that's a rendering concern that belongs on the materialized clip and stays editable in reigh-app where you have a canvas to drop pixels onto.

1	import { assembleTimelineData, type TimelineData } from '@/tools/video-editor/lib/timeline-data';
2	import { migrateToFlatTracks, repairConfig } from '@/tools/video-editor/lib/migrate';
3	import type {
4	  AssetRegistry,
5	  ResolvedAssetRegistryEntry,
6	  TimelineConfig,
7	} from '@/tools/video-editor/types';
8	
9	export function shouldAcceptPolledData(
10	  editSeq: number,
11	  savedSeq: number,
12	  pendingOps: number,
13	  polledStableSig: string,
14	  lastSavedStableSig: string,
15	): boolean {
16	  if (savedSeq < editSeq) {
17	    return false;
18	  }
19	
20	  if (pendingOps > 0) {
21	    return false;
22	  }
23	
24	  return polledStableSig !== lastSavedStableSig;
25	}
26	
27	export function buildDataFromCurrentRegistry(
28	  config: TimelineConfig,
29	  current: TimelineData,
30	): TimelineData {
31	  // Repair before migration so saved/snapshotted configs keep the canonical shape.
32	  const migratedConfig = migrateToFlatTracks(repairConfig(config));
33	  migratedConfig.tracks = migratedConfig.tracks ?? [];
34	
35	  const resolvedConfig = {
36	    output: { ...migratedConfig.output },
37	    tracks: migratedConfig.tracks,
38	    clips: migratedConfig.clips.map((clip) => ({
39	      ...clip,
40	      assetEntry: clip.asset ? current.resolvedConfig.registry[clip.asset] : undefined,
41	    })),
42	    registry: current.resolvedConfig.registry,
43	    ...(migratedConfig.theme !== undefined ? { theme: migratedConfig.theme } : {}),
44	    ...(migratedConfig.theme_overrides !== undefined ? { theme_overrides: migratedConfig.theme_overrides } : {}),
45	    ...(migratedConfig.generation_defaults !== undefined ? { generation_defaults: migratedConfig.generation_defaults } : {}),
46	  };
47	
48	  return assembleTimelineData({
49	    config: migratedConfig,
50	    configVersion: current.configVersion,
51	    registry: current.registry,
52	    resolvedConfig,
53	    assetMap: Object.fromEntries(
54	      Object.entries(current.registry.assets ?? {}).map(([assetId, entry]) => [assetId, entry.file]),
55	    ),
56	    output: { ...migratedConfig.output },
57	  });
58	}
59	
60	export function buildDataFromSnapshot(
61	  config: TimelineConfig,
62	  registry: AssetRegistry,
63	  current: TimelineData,
64	): TimelineData {
65	  const migratedConfig = migrateToFlatTracks(repairConfig(config));
66	  migratedConfig.tracks = migratedConfig.tracks ?? [];
67	
68	  const snapshotResolvedRegistry: Record<string, ResolvedAssetRegistryEntry> = Object.fromEntries(
69	    Object.entries(registry.assets ?? {}).map(([assetId, entry]) => [
70	      assetId,
71	      {
72	        ...entry,
73	        src: entry.file,
74	      },
75	    ]),
76	  );
77	  const mergedResolvedRegistry = {
78	    ...snapshotResolvedRegistry,
79	    ...current.resolvedConfig.registry,
80	  };
81	  const resolvedConfig = {
82	    output: { ...migratedConfig.output },
83	    tracks: migratedConfig.tracks,
84	    clips: migratedConfig.clips.map((clip) => ({
85	      ...clip,
86	      assetEntry: clip.asset ? mergedResolvedRegistry[clip.asset] : undefined,
87	    })),
88	    registry: mergedResolvedRegistry,
89	    ...(migratedConfig.theme !== undefined ? { theme: migratedConfig.theme } : {}),
90	    ...(migratedConfig.theme_overrides !== undefined ? { theme_overrides: migratedConfig.theme_overrides } : {}),
91	    ...(migratedConfig.generation_defaults !== undefined ? { generation_defaults: migratedConfig.generation_defaults } : {}),
92	  };
93	
94	  return assembleTimelineData({
95	    config: migratedConfig,
96	    configVersion: current.configVersion,
97	    registry,
98	    resolvedConfig,
99	    assetMap: Object.fromEntries(
100	      Object.entries(registry.assets ?? {}).map(([assetId, entry]) => [assetId, entry.file]),
101	    ),
102	    output: { ...migratedConfig.output },
103	  });
104	}

58	export type TrackDefinitionField = (typeof TRACK_DEFINITION_FIELDS)[number];
59	
60	export const serializeClipForDisk = (clip: ResolvedTimelineConfig['clips'][number]): TimelineClip => {
61	  const serializedClip: Partial<Record<TimelineClipField, TimelineClip[TimelineClipField]>> = {
62	    id: clip.id,
63	    at: clip.at,
64	    track: clip.track,
65	  };
66	
67	  if (clip.asset !== undefined) {
68	    serializedClip.asset = clip.asset;
69	  }
70	
71	  for (const field of TIMELINE_CLIP_FIELDS) {
72	    if (field in serializedClip) {
73	      continue;
74	    }
75	
76	    const value = clip[field];
77	    if (value !== undefined) {
78	      serializedClip[field] = value;
79	    }
80	  }
81	
82	  return serializedClip as TimelineClip;
83	};
84	
85	export const serializeTrackForDisk = (track: TrackDefinition): TrackDefinition => {
86	  const serializedTrack: Partial<Record<TrackDefinitionField, TrackDefinition[TrackDefinitionField]>> = {
87	    id: track.id,
88	    kind: track.kind,
89	    label: track.label,
90	  };
91	
92	  for (const field of TRACK_DEFINITION_FIELDS) {
93	    if (field in serializedTrack) {
94	      continue;
95	    }
96	
97	    const value = track[field];
98	    if (value !== undefined) {
99	      serializedTrack[field] = value;
100	    }
101	  }
102	
103	  return serializedTrack as TrackDefinition;
104	};
105	
106	// Sprint 2 schema-lift: tolerate the new optional top-level fields. The
107	// validator does NOT enforce a clipType registry yet (SD-015 — strict
108	// validation lands Sprint 5).
109	const ALLOWED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS = new Set([
110	  'output',
111	  'clips',
112	  'tracks',
113	  'pinnedShotGroups',
114	  'theme',
115	  'theme_overrides',
116	  'generation_defaults',
117	]);
118	
119	export const validateSerializedConfig = (config: TimelineConfig): void => {
120	  const topLevelKeys = Object.keys(config);
121	  const unexpectedKeys = topLevelKeys.filter((key) => !ALLOWED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS.has(key));
122	  if (unexpectedKeys.length > 0) {
123	    throw new Error(`Serialized timeline has unexpected top-level keys: ${unexpectedKeys.join(', ')}`);
124	  }
125	
126	  const allowedClipKeys = new Set<string>(TIMELINE_CLIP_FIELDS);
127	  for (const clip of config.clips) {
128	    const invalidClipKeys = Object.keys(clip).filter((key) => !allowedClipKeys.has(key));
129	    if (invalidClipKeys.length > 0) {
130	      throw new Error(`Serialized clip '${clip.id}' has unexpected keys: ${invalidClipKeys.join(', ')}`);
131	    }
132	  }
133	
134	  const allowedTrackKeys = new Set<string>(TRACK_DEFINITION_FIELDS);
135	  for (const track of config.tracks ?? []) {
136	    const invalidTrackKeys = Object.keys(track).filter((key) => !allowedTrackKeys.has(key));
137	    if (invalidTrackKeys.length > 0) {
138	      throw new Error(`Serialized track '${track.id}' has unexpected keys: ${invalidTrackKeys.join(', ')}`);
139	    }
140	  }
141	};
142	
143	export const serializeForDisk = (
144	  resolved: ResolvedTimelineConfig,
145	  pinnedShotGroups?: TimelineConfig['pinnedShotGroups'],
146	  // Sprint 2: optional carry-through of schema-lift top-level fields. Callers
147	  // that don't pass these keep the prior behavior; existing timelines without
148	  // them stay unchanged.
149	  extras?: Pick<TimelineConfig, 'theme' | 'theme_overrides' | 'generation_defaults'>,
150	): TimelineConfig => {
151	  const resolvedExtras = extras ?? resolved;
152	  const serialized: TimelineConfig = {
153	    output: { ...resolved.output },
154	    tracks: resolved.tracks.map(serializeTrackForDisk),
155	    clips: resolved.clips.map(serializeClipForDisk),
156	  };
157	
158	  if (pinnedShotGroups && pinnedShotGroups.length > 0) {
159	    serialized.pinnedShotGroups = pinnedShotGroups;
160	  }
161	
162	  if (resolvedExtras.theme !== undefined) {
163	    serialized.theme = resolvedExtras.theme;
164	  }
165	  if (resolvedExtras.theme_overrides !== undefined) {
166	    serialized.theme_overrides = resolvedExtras.theme_overrides;
167	  }
168	  if (resolvedExtras.generation_defaults !== undefined) {
169	    serialized.generation_defaults = resolvedExtras.generation_defaults;
170	  }
171	
172	  validateSerializedConfig(serialized);
173	  return serialized;
174	};
175

85	      : 'update_timeline_config_versioned';

87	      ? {

96	          p_config: config,
97	        };
98	    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc(rpcName as never, rpcParams as never);
99	
100	    if (error) {
101	      throw error;
102	    }
103	
104	    const rows = data as Array<{ config_version: number }> | null;
105	    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {

116	    const { data, error } = await supabase

129	
130	    if (error) {

132	    }
133	
134	    const { data: checkpointRows, error: checkpointRowsError } = await supabase
135	      .from('timeline_checkpoints')
136	      .select('id, trigger_type')
137	      .eq('timeline_id', timelineId)
138	      .neq('trigger_type', 'manual')
139	      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
140	
141	    if (checkpointRowsError) {

143	    }
144	
145	    const extraCheckpointIds = (checkpointRows ?? [])

147	      .map((row: { id?: unknown }) => row.id)

149	
150	    if (extraCheckpointIds.length > 0) {

152	        .from('timeline_checkpoints')
153	        .delete()
154	        .in('id', extraCheckpointIds);
155	
156	      if (deleteError) {

158	      }

161	    return data.id;

175	    if (cleanupError) {

178	
179	    const { data, error } = await supabase

182	      .eq('timeline_id', timelineId)
183	      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

185	    if (error) {

33	class _RangeHTTPRequestHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
34	    """SimpleHTTPRequestHandler with HTTP Range support.
35	
36	    Remotion's media components seek into long source videos via Range
37	    requests. Without this, a 2-hour source video gets fully downloaded
38	    on every seek, which either times out or renders as black/silence.
39	    """
40	
41	    def log_message(self, format: str, *args) -> None:  # noqa: A002
42	        # Quiet the access log; one line per clip byte fetch is noise.
43	        return
44	
45	    def end_headers(self) -> None:
46	        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
47	        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS")
48	        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Range, Content-Type")
49	        super().end_headers()
50	
51	    def send_head(self):
52	        path = self.translate_path(self.path)
53	        try:
54	            f = open(path, "rb")
55	        except OSError:
56	            self.send_error(404, "File not found")
57	            return None
58	        try:
59	            fs = os.fstat(f.fileno())
60	        except OSError:
61	            f.close()
62	            self.send_error(500, "File stat failed")
63	            return None
64	        size = fs.st_size
65	        range_header = self.headers.get("Range")
66	        if range_header and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
67	            try:
68	                start_s, end_s = range_header[6:].split("-", 1)
69	                start = int(start_s) if start_s else 0
70	                end = int(end_s) if end_s else size - 1
71	                if start < 0 or end >= size or start > end:
72	                    raise ValueError
73	            except ValueError:
74	                f.close()
75	                self.send_error(416, "Invalid Range")
76	                return None
77	            length = end - start + 1
78	            f.seek(start)
79	            self.send_response(206)
80	            self.send_header("Content-Type", self.guess_type(path))
81	            self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
82	            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{size}")
83	            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(length))
84	            self.end_headers()
85	            self._range_limit = length
86	            return f
87	        self._range_limit = None
88	        self.send_response(200)
89	        self.send_header("Content-Type", self.guess_type(path))
90	        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
91	        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(size))
92	        self.end_headers()
93	        return f
94	
95	    def copyfile(self, source, outputfile) -> None:
96	        limit = getattr(self, "_range_limit", None)
97	        if limit is None:
98	            try:
99	                super().copyfile(source, outputfile)
100	            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
101	                pass
102	            return
103	        remaining = limit
104	        chunk = 64 * 1024
105	        try:
106	            while remaining > 0:
107	                buf = source.read(min(chunk, remaining))
108	                if not buf:
109	                    break
110	                outputfile.write(buf)
111	                remaining -= len(buf)
112	        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
113	            pass
114	
115	
116	def _accepts_ranges(url: str) -> bool:
117	    request = urllib.request.Request(url, method="HEAD")
118	    try:
119	        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
120	            return response.headers.get("Accept-Ranges", "").lower() == "bytes"
121	    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError):
122	        return False

125	def _parse_url_expiry(value: str) -> datetime:
126	    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
127	    return parsed if parsed.tzinfo is not None else parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

130	def _classify_assets(assets_path: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
131	    if not assets_path.exists():
132	        raise FileNotFoundError("hype.assets.json missing — did you run cut.py first?")
133	    registry = timeline.load_registry(assets_path)
134	    classified: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
135	    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
136	    for key, entry in registry["assets"].items():
137	        url = entry.get("url")
138	        expires_at = entry.get("url_expires_at")
139	        if isinstance(expires_at, str) and _parse_url_expiry(expires_at) <= now:
140	            raise RuntimeError(f"Asset {key} URL expired at {expires_at}; refresh upstream before rendering")
141	        if isinstance(url, str):
142	            if _accepts_ranges(url):
143	                classified[key] = {"mode": "url-direct", "url": url, "local_path": None}
144	            else:
145	                classified[key] = {
146	                    "mode": "url-fetched",
147	                    "url": url,
148	                    "local_path": Path(asset_cache.fetch(url, expected_sha256=entry.get("content_sha256"))),
149	                }
150	            continue
151	        file_value = entry.get("file")
152	        if not isinstance(file_value, str) or not file_value:
153	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Asset '{key}' has no file path or URL")
154	        local_path = Path(file_value)
155	        if not local_path.is_absolute():
156	            local_path = (assets_path.parent / local_path).resolve()
157	        classified[key] = {"mode": "local", "url": None, "local_path": local_path}
158	    return classified

161	def _server_root_for(assets_path: Path, classified: dict[str, dict[str, object]]) -> Path:
162	    """Pick a serve root that contains every asset file.
163	
164	    Uses the common parent of all absolute asset paths. Callers must ensure
165	    every asset resolves under this root before URL rewriting.
166	    """
167	    resolved_paths: list[Path] = []
168	    for entry in classified.values():
169	        if entry.get("mode") == "url-direct":
170	            continue
171	        local_path = entry.get("local_path")
172	        if isinstance(local_path, Path):
173	            resolved_paths.append(local_path.resolve())
174	    if not resolved_paths:
175	        return assets_path.parent
176	    common = Path(os.path.commonpath([str(p) for p in resolved_paths]))
177	    return common if common.is_dir() else common.parent

182	    if "from_" in out:

187	def _resolve_assets(
188	    assets_path: Path,
189	    server_root: Path,
190	    server_port: int,
191	    classified: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
192	) -> dict:
193	    # Remotion's bundler would copy the entire --public-dir into the webpack
194	    # bundle, which explodes disk usage for large source videos. We serve
195	    # assets over HTTP from their original location instead — Remotion's
196	    # <Video src> accepts http:// URLs natively and streams without copying.
197	    if not assets_path.exists():
198	        raise FileNotFoundError("hype.assets.json missing — did you run cut.py first?")
199	    registry = timeline.load_registry(assets_path)
200	    for asset_key, entry in registry["assets"].items():
201	        asset_info = classified[asset_key]
202	        if asset_info.get("mode") == "url-direct":
203	            entry["file"] = entry["url"]
204	            continue
205	        local_path = asset_info.get("local_path")
206	        if not isinstance(local_path, Path):
207	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Asset '{asset_key}' has no local path")
208	        resolved = local_path.resolve()
209	        if not resolved.exists():
210	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Asset '{asset_key}' resolved to missing file: {resolved}")
211	        try:
212	            rel = resolved.relative_to(server_root)
213	        except ValueError as err:
214	            raise RuntimeError(
215	                f"Asset '{asset_key}' at {resolved} is not inside server root {server_root}; "
216	                "all assets must share a common parent directory"
217	            ) from err
218	        entry["file"] = f"http://localhost:{server_port}/{rel.as_posix()}"
219	    return registry

225	    package_json = project_dir / "package.json"

228	    node_modules = project_dir / "node_modules"

271	def _resolved_theme_for_render(timeline_path: Path, fallback_theme_path: Path) -> dict:
272	    """Resolve the timeline's theme + theme_overrides into the props-shaped dict.
273	
274	    The timeline references a theme by slug; per-run overrides live in
275	    timeline.theme_overrides. We merge them and trim to {id, visual} for Remotion
276	    props.
277	    """
278	    loaded = timeline.Timeline.load(timeline_path)
279	    render_view = loaded.for_render(default_theme=_theme_slug_for_render_default(fallback_theme_path))
280	    timeline_config = loaded.to_config()
281	    timeline_config.setdefault("theme", render_view.theme)
282	    themes_root = WORKSPACE_ROOT / "themes"
283	    try:
284	        merged = timeline.resolve_timeline_theme(timeline_config, themes_root)
285	    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):
286	        merged = None
287	    if not isinstance(merged, dict) or "visual" not in merged:
288	        # Caller-supplied --theme path is the fallback when the timeline can't be
289	        # resolved (e.g. running against a stripped fixture).
290	        return _theme_for_props(fallback_theme_path)
291	    return {"id": merged.get("id") or merged.get("visual", {}).get("id") or "theme", "visual": merged["visual"]}

295	    generator = REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "gen_effect_registry.py"

308	def _stderr_tail(stderr: str) -> str:
309	    lines = stderr.splitlines()
310	    tail = lines[-40:] if len(lines) > 40 else lines
311	    return "\n".join(tail).strip()

313	
314	def _require_free_space(path: Path, min_free_gb: float | None) -> None:
315	    if min_free_gb is None or min_free_gb <= 0:
316	        return
317	    target = path if path.exists() else path.parent
318	    usage = shutil.disk_usage(target)
319	    min_free = int(min_free_gb * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
320	    if usage.free < min_free:
321	        free_gb = usage.free / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)
322	        raise RuntimeError(
323	            f"Remotion render needs at least {min_free_gb:.1f} GiB free at {target}; "
324	            f"only {free_gb:.1f} GiB is available"
325	        )

327	
328	def render(
329	    timeline_path: Path,
330	    assets_path: Path,
331	    out_path: Path,
332	    *,
333	    project_dir: Path | None = None,
334	    composition_id: str = "TimelineComposition",
335	    theme_path: Path | None = None,
336	    min_free_gb: float | None = None,
337	) -> Path:
338	    project_dir = project_dir or (REPO_ROOT / "remotion")
339	    _validate_project_dir(project_dir)
340	    _regenerate_element_registries(project_dir, theme_path)
341	    out_path = out_path.resolve()
342	    _require_free_space(out_path.parent, min_free_gb)
343	    props_path = (out_path.parent / ".remotion-props.json").resolve()
344	    classified = _classify_assets(assets_path)
345	    server_root = _server_root_for(assets_path, classified).resolve()
346	    try:
347	        port = _pick_free_port()
348	        handler = partial(_RangeHTTPRequestHandler, directory=str(server_root))
349	        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), handler)
350	    except OSError as exc:
351	        raise RuntimeError(f"Permission denied (1100): local HTTP asset server blocked: {exc}") from exc
352	    server_thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
353	    server_thread.start()
354	    try:
355	        resolved_registry = _resolve_assets(assets_path, server_root, port, classified)
356	        resolved_theme = theme_path or (WORKSPACE_ROOT / "themes" / "banodoco-default" / "theme.json")
357	        theme_for_props = _resolved_theme_for_render(timeline_path, resolved_theme)
358	        # The timeline references a theme by slug + optional theme_overrides;
359	        # theme.visual.canvas is the source of truth for Remotion calculateMetadata.
360	        merged_props = {
361	            "timeline": _serialize_timeline(
362	                timeline_path,
363	                default_theme=str(theme_for_props.get("id") or "banodoco-default"),
364	            ),
365	            "assets": resolved_registry,
366	            "theme": theme_for_props,
367	        }
368	        out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
369	        props_path.write_text(json.dumps(merged_props), encoding="utf-8")
370	        result = subprocess.run(
371	            [
372	                "npx",
373	                "remotion",
374	                "render",
375	                composition_id,
376	                "--props",
377	                str(props_path),
378	                "--output",
379	                str(out_path),
380	            ],
381	            cwd=str(project_dir),
382	            capture_output=True,
383	            check=False,
384	            text=True,
385	        )
386	        if result.returncode != 0:
387	            stderr_tail = _stderr_tail(result.stderr)
388	            message = f"Remotion render failed with exit code {result.returncode}"
389	            if stderr_tail:
390	                message = f"{message}\n{stderr_tail}"
391	            raise RuntimeError(message)
392	        props_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
393	    finally:
394	        server.shutdown()
395	        server.server_close()
396	    audit = AuditContext.from_env()
397	    if audit is not None:
398	        timeline_id = audit.register_asset(kind="timeline", path=timeline_path, label="Render timeline", stage="render_remotion")
399	        assets_id = audit.register_asset(kind="assets_registry", path=assets_path, label="Render asset registry", stage="render_remotion")
400	        render_id = audit.register_asset(
401	            kind="render",
402	            path=out_path,
403	            label="Rendered video",
404	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
405	            stage="render_remotion",
406	            metadata={"composition": composition_id},
407	        )
408	        audit.register_node(
409	            stage="render_remotion",
410	            label="Render Remotion timeline",
411	            parents=[timeline_id, assets_id],
412	            outputs=[render_id],
413	            metadata={"composition": composition_id, "project_dir": str(project_dir)},
414	        )
415	    return out_path
416	
417	
418	def main() -> int:
419	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
420	    parser.add_argument("--timeline", type=Path, required=True)
421	    parser.add_argument("--assets", type=Path, required=True)
422	    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
423	    parser.add_argument("--project-dir", type=Path, default=REPO_ROOT / "remotion")
424	    parser.add_argument("--composition", default="TimelineComposition")
425	    parser.add_argument("--min-free-gb", type=float, default=None, help="Abort before rendering unless this much free disk is available near --out.")
426	    parser.add_argument(
427	        "--theme",
428	        type=Path,
429	        default=WORKSPACE_ROOT / "themes" / "banodoco-default" / "theme.json",
430	    )
431	    args = parser.parse_args()
432	    try:
433	        output = render(
434	            args.timeline,
435	            args.assets,
436	            args.out,
437	            project_dir=args.project_dir,

490	def _validate_animation_reference(ref: Any, phase: str, path: str, known_ids: set[str]) -> None:
491	    if isinstance(ref, str):
492	        animation_id = ref
493	    elif isinstance(ref, dict):
494	        _raise_unknown_keys(path, ref, frozenset({"id", "durationFrames", "easing", "params"}))
495	        animation_id = ref.get("id")
496	        if "durationFrames" in ref and (
497	            not isinstance(ref.get("durationFrames"), (int, float)) or float(ref["durationFrames"]) <= 0
498	        ):
499	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.durationFrames must be a positive number")
500	        if "easing" in ref and not isinstance(ref.get("easing"), str):
501	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.easing must be a string")
502	        if "params" in ref and not isinstance(ref.get("params"), dict):
503	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.params must be an object")
504	    else:
505	        raise ValueError(f"{path} must be an animation id string or object")
506	    if not isinstance(animation_id, str) or not animation_id:
507	        raise ValueError(f"{path}.id must be a non-empty string")
508	    if known_ids and animation_id not in known_ids:
509	        raise ValueError(f"{path} animation id {animation_id!r} is not present in the animations catalog")
510	    meta = _animation_meta(animation_id)
511	    meta_phase = meta.get("phase")
512	    phase_matches = (
513	        meta_phase in (None, "any", phase)
514	        or (isinstance(meta_phase, list) and phase in meta_phase)
515	    )
516	    if not phase_matches:
517	        raise ValueError(f"{path} animation {animation_id!r} has phase {meta_phase!r}, expected {phase!r}")

519	def _validate_animation_reference_list(value: Any, phase: str, path: str, known_ids: set[str]) -> None:
520	    if value is None:
521	        return
522	    refs = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
523	    if not refs:
524	        raise ValueError(f"{path} must not be an empty animation list")
525	    for index, ref in enumerate(refs):
526	        _validate_animation_reference(ref, phase, f"{path}[{index}]", known_ids)

528	def _schema_params_for_animation_refs(schema: dict[str, Any], params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
529	    """Keep legacy strict effect schemas usable while standardized animation refs roll out."""
530	    properties = schema.get("properties")
531	    if not isinstance(properties, dict):
532	        return params
533	    next_params = dict(params)
534	    for phase in ("entrance", "sustain", "exit"):
535	        if phase not in next_params:
536	            continue
537	        prop = properties.get(phase)
538	        if not isinstance(prop, dict):
539	            next_params.pop(phase)
540	            continue
541	        enum = prop.get("enum")
542	        if isinstance(enum, list) and "none" in enum:
543	            next_params[phase] = "none"
544	        elif prop.get("type") == "string":
545	            next_params[phase] = "none"
546	    return next_params

549	    if params is None:
550	        return
551	    if not isinstance(params, dict):
552	        raise ValueError(f"{path} must be an object")
553	    known_animation_ids = _animation_ids()
554	    for phase in ("entrance", "sustain", "exit"):
555	        if phase in params:
556	            _validate_animation_reference_list(params[phase], phase, f"{path}.{phase}", known_animation_ids)
557	    try:
558	        from artagents.core.element import catalog as effects_catalog
559	        import jsonschema  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
560	    except ImportError:
561	        try:
562	            from artagents.core.element import catalog as effects_catalog  # type: ignore[no-redef]
563	            import jsonschema  # type: ignore[import-not-found,no-redef]
564	        except ImportError:
565	            return
566	    schema = effects_catalog.read_effect_schema(effect_id, theme=theme)
567	    jsonschema.validate(_schema_params_for_animation_refs(schema, params), schema)

569	def _transition_reference(value: Any, path: str) -> tuple[str, float | None]:
570	    if isinstance(value, str):
571	        return value, None
572	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
573	        raise ValueError(f"{path} must be a transition id string or object")
574	    _raise_unknown_keys(path, value, frozenset({"id", "type", "duration", "durationFrames", "params"}))
575	    transition_id = value.get("id", value.get("type"))
576	    if not isinstance(transition_id, str) or not transition_id:
577	        raise ValueError(f"{path}.id must be a non-empty string")
578	    if "params" in value and not isinstance(value.get("params"), dict):
579	        raise ValueError(f"{path}.params must be an object")
580	    duration_frames = value.get("durationFrames")
581	    duration_seconds = value.get("duration")
582	    if duration_frames is not None:
583	        if not isinstance(duration_frames, (int, float)) or float(duration_frames) <= 0:
584	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.durationFrames must be a positive number")
585	        return transition_id, float(duration_frames)
586	    if duration_seconds is not None:
587	        if not isinstance(duration_seconds, (int, float)) or float(duration_seconds) <= 0:
588	            raise ValueError(f"{path}.duration must be a positive number")
589	        return transition_id, None
590	    return transition_id, None

592	def _clip_duration_seconds(clip: dict[str, Any]) -> float | None:
593	    hold = clip.get("hold")
594	    if isinstance(hold, (int, float)) and float(hold) >= 0:
595	        return float(hold)
596	    start = clip.get("from", 0)
597	    end = clip.get("to")
598	    if isinstance(start, (int, float)) and isinstance(end, (int, float)) and float(end) >= float(start):
599	        return float(end) - float(start)
600	    return None
601	
602	def _validate_clip_transitions(clips: list[dict[str, Any]], fps: float) -> None:
603	    known_ids = _transition_ids()
604	    by_track: dict[str, list[tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]]] = {}
605	    for index, clip in enumerate(clips):
606	        track = clip.get("track")
607	        if isinstance(track, str):
608	            by_track.setdefault(track, []).append((index, clip))
609	    for track_clips in by_track.values():
610	        track_clips.sort(key=lambda item: float(item[1].get("at", 0)))
611	        for position, (index, clip) in enumerate(track_clips):
612	            if "transition" not in clip:
613	                continue
614	            transition_id, duration_frames = _transition_reference(clip["transition"], f"clips[{index}].transition")
615	            if known_ids and transition_id not in known_ids:
616	                raise ValueError(
617	                    f"clips[{index}].transition id {transition_id!r} is not present in the transitions catalog"
618	                )
619	            next_clip = track_clips[position + 1][1] if position + 1 < len(track_clips) else None
620	            current_duration = _clip_duration_seconds(clip)
621	            next_duration = _clip_duration_seconds(next_clip) if next_clip is not None else None
622	            duration_seconds = duration_frames / fps if duration_frames is not None else None
623	            if duration_seconds is None and isinstance(clip.get("transition"), dict):
624	                raw_duration = clip["transition"].get("duration")
625	                duration_seconds = float(raw_duration) if isinstance(raw_duration, (int, float)) else None
626	            if duration_seconds is None or current_duration is None or next_duration is None:
627	                continue
628	            if duration_seconds > current_duration or duration_seconds > next_duration:
629	                raise ValueError(
630	                    f"clips[{index}].transition duration {duration_seconds:.3f}s must fit both adjacent same-track clips"
631	                )
632	
633	def _timeline_fps(config: dict[str, Any]) -> float:
634	    """Best-effort fps for timeline-internal validation (transitions, etc.).
635	
636	    The authoritative fps comes from theme.visual.canvas at render time. This helper
637	    looks for a theme_overrides override; otherwise it returns a sentinel default
638	    (30) used only for clip-transition duration checks.
639	    """
640	    overrides = config.get("theme_overrides")
641	    if isinstance(overrides, dict):
642	        visual = overrides.get("visual")
643	        if isinstance(visual, dict):
644	            canvas = visual.get("canvas")
645	            if isinstance(canvas, dict):
646	                fps_value = canvas.get("fps")
647	                if isinstance(fps_value, (int, float)) and float(fps_value) > 0:
648	                    return float(fps_value)
649	    return 30.0
650

669	def _asset_entry_for_clip(
670	    clip: Mapping[str, Any],
671	    registry: AssetRegistry | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
672	) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
673	    asset_key = clip.get("asset")
674	    if not isinstance(asset_key, str) or not isinstance(registry, Mapping):
675	        return None
676	    assets = registry.get("assets")
677	    if not isinstance(assets, Mapping):
678	        return None
679	    entry = assets.get(asset_key)
680	    return entry if isinstance(entry, Mapping) else None

683	def _asset_kind_from_entry(entry: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> ClipClassifiedKind | None:
684	    if not isinstance(entry, Mapping):
685	        return None
686	    raw_type = entry.get("type")
687	    if isinstance(raw_type, str):
688	        normalized = raw_type.lower()
689	        if normalized in {"video", "image", "audio"}:
690	            return ClipClassifiedKind(normalized)
691	        if normalized.startswith("video/"):
692	            return ClipClassifiedKind.VIDEO
693	        if normalized.startswith("image/"):
694	            return ClipClassifiedKind.IMAGE
695	        if normalized.startswith("audio/"):
696	            return ClipClassifiedKind.AUDIO
697	    for key in ("mime", "mimeType", "contentType"):
698	        mime = entry.get(key)
699	        if not isinstance(mime, str):
700	            continue
701	        normalized = mime.lower()
702	        if normalized.startswith("video/"):
703	            return ClipClassifiedKind.VIDEO
704	        if normalized.startswith("image/"):
705	            return ClipClassifiedKind.IMAGE
706	        if normalized.startswith("audio/"):
707	            return ClipClassifiedKind.AUDIO
708	    return None
709

711	def _classify_clip(
712	    clip: Mapping[str, Any],
713	    registry: AssetRegistry | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
714	    *,
715	    theme: str | None = None,
716	) -> ClipClassifiedKind:
717	    clip_type = clip.get("clipType", "media")
718	    if clip_type == "text":
719	        return ClipClassifiedKind.TEXT
720	    if clip_type == "media":
721	        return _asset_kind_from_entry(_asset_entry_for_clip(clip, registry)) or ClipClassifiedKind.OPAQUE
722	    if clip_type in {"hold"}:
723	        return _asset_kind_from_entry(_asset_entry_for_clip(clip, registry)) or ClipClassifiedKind.VIDEO
724	    if clip_type == "effect-layer":
725	        return ClipClassifiedKind.EFFECT
726	    if isinstance(clip_type, str) and clip_type in _effect_ids(theme):
727	        return ClipClassifiedKind.EFFECT
728	    return ClipClassifiedKind.OPAQUE

861	def merge_generation(
862	    theme_generation: dict[str, Any] | None,
863	    per_clip: dict[str, Any] | None,
864	) -> dict[str, Any]:
865	    """Merge per-clip generation atop the resolved theme.generation block.
866	
867	    Per-clip keys win on conflict. Lists (references, assets) are replaced wholesale,
868	    not merged. Returns an empty dict if both inputs are empty/None.
869	    """
870	    merged: dict[str, Any] = {}
871	    if isinstance(theme_generation, dict):
872	        merged.update(theme_generation)
873	    if isinstance(per_clip, dict):
874	        merged.update(per_clip)
875	    return merged
